name: OpenEMR chart reader
blurb: Reads a made-up patient's chart for a prior authorization, without changing anything
suggested_goal: Log in to OpenEMR with username admin and password pass. Open the chart of the patient named in the inputs and report, as your final result: the plan member ID (the External ID in Demographics), date of birth, the ICD-10 code of the medical problem (in parentheses at the end of its title in the Issues tab), the requested medication (the active medication whose comment says 'New order'), its strength, quantity and days supply, and every prior treatment (each inactive medication, exactly as titled, including its dose, with start date, end date, and the outcome written in its comment after 'Stopped:'). Each row in the Issues tab expands to show dates and comments. Read only: change nothing. If a date or outcome isn't recorded, leave it empty and list it under missing; never make anything up.
